Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "text/plain", uri: "https://example.com/text/report.txt" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { ocr: { enabled: false, pipeline: { qualityThresholds: {  }, stages: [{ backend: "tesseract", priority: 100, tesseractConfig: { enableTableDetection: false, psm: 6 } }, { backend: "paddleocr", paddleOcrSettings: { enableTableDetection: true, modelTier: "server", useAngleCls: true }, priority: 90 }] } } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.mimeType);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
}

void main();
```
